name: pluto
description: Notebook for JS/TS, Postgres, SQLite, DuckDB and Polars in a single binary

scripts.build: npm run gen && npm run build:web && bun build src/server.ts --compile --minify --outfile example/pluto
scripts.dev: npm run gen && npm run build:web && bun src/server.ts --file example/notebook.json
scripts.build:web: bun build src/web/editor.ts src/web/ts-worker.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outdir dist
